channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Iranian regime is ‘toast’ says US secretary of war
item.description: The US Secretary of Defence announced the sinking in a press conference earlier. Pete Hegseth described the Iranian regime as "toast" and hailed the "quiet death" inflicted on those aboard the warship.

item.title: ‘Only way conflict ends is through diplomacy’- Former Qatari defence attaché
item.description: We spoke to Nawaf Al Thani, former Qatari Defence Attaché to the US.

item.title: Israeli strikes hit Beirut hotel as civilians told to evacuate southern Lebanon
item.description: Lebanon's president has urged the US to intervene to stop Israel's strikes in his country.

item.title: ‘This is not a war of our choice’ – Israeli government spokesperson
item.description: We spoke to David Mencer, spokesperson to the Israeli Prime Minister's Office.

item.title: Keir Starmer defends government’s approach to Iran war
item.description: The first government chartered flight to evacuate British nationals from the Middle East is leaving Oman tonight.

item.title: Concerns grow over impact of Iran war on oil and gas prices
item.description: Energy costs have stabilised and share prices have risen today on hopes that the US military will protect shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: ‘Trump has thrown hand grenade into vulnerable world’ – US economist
item.description: We spoke to Nobel Prize winning economist Joseph Stiglitz.

item.title: Are the US and Israel arming Kurdish groups to take on Iran?
item.description: As the US and Israel plan the next phase of this conflict, it's being reported they're looking to arm and support Iranian Kurdish groups along the Iran-Iraq border, in the hope they will take part in a ground operation and force regime change - though the White House has denied this.

item.title: A filmmaker’s footage from inside war-torn Iran
item.description: We bring you a report from our filmmaker in Tehran, who we aren't naming for his own safety.

item.title: Channel 4 News programme recognised for Gaza coverage, political reporting and ‘Fall of Assad’ at 2026 RTS Awards
item.description: Five wins, including Programme of the Year, and eight nominations, marks Channel 4 News’ most successful RTS for four award cycles.
